description: This header file declares functions and constants related to the status loop and console functionality for the firmware, including initialization, logging, and status updating mechanisms.

methods.name: prepareTunerStudioOutputs
methods.description: Prepares outputs for Tuner Studio interface.

methods.name: startStatusThreads
methods.description: Starts threads for managing status updates.

methods.name: writeLogLine
methods.description: Writes a log line to the log buffer or output.

methods.name: getFullLog
methods.description: Returns whether the full log is enabled.

methods.name: setFullLog
methods.description: Enables or disables full logging based on the given value.

methods.name: printOverallStatus
methods.description: Prints the overall system status, taking current time in seconds.
